_comment: Console folder name (as used under the Emulation/ R2 prefix, e.g. Emulation/NES/) -> EmulatorJS EJS_core identifier. Add a ROM by dropping it into Emulation/<ConsoleName>/ using one of the console names below -- /api/emulation looks up the matching core from this file automatically. Core values verified 2026-08 against https://emulatorjs.org/docs/options/ and the per-system pages under https://emulatorjs.org/docs/systems/ -- that systems index page itself warns it can be stale, which is exactly what bit us with GB (was 'gameboy', a dead legacy alias -- the CDN only hosts 'gb').
